descriptions.TNDLib.Algebra.product: Folds a list with an explicitly supplied binary operation and identity element.
descriptions.TNDLib.Algebra.productAppend: Shows that list product preserves append when the operation is associative and has a left identity.
descriptions.TNDLib.Algebra.productCons: Unfolds the product of a nonempty list at its leading element.
descriptions.TNDLib.Algebra.productNil: Identifies the product of the empty list with the supplied identity.
descriptions.TNDLib.Algebra.productSingleton: Identifies a singleton product with its element when the identity is right unital.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.DiscrepancyAt: Specifies that stream f differs from stream g at coordinate n by taking the flipped value.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.DiscrepancyWitness: Specifies that a candidate binary stream differs from the n-th enumerated stream at diagonal index n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.diagonal: Constructs the diagonal binary stream n ↦ flip (enum n n) from an enumeration of streams.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.diagonalDiscrepancy: Constructs the explicit diagonal discrepancy witness for every enumerated stream index n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.diagonal_differ_at: Proves that the diagonal stream differs from the n-th enumerated stream at index n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.flip: Negates a boolean symbol constructively via Bool.casesOn.
descriptions.TNDLib.Cantor.flip_ne_self: Proves constructively that no boolean equals its flipped value.
descriptions.TNDLib.Certifying.MatchAt2: Specifies a length-2 binary pattern match in a stream at position pos.
descriptions.TNDLib.Certifying.MismatchWitness2: Specifies an explicit offset-0 or offset-1 mismatch certificate refuting a length-2 match.
descriptions.TNDLib.Certifying.StreamDiscrepancyCert: Specifies a cross-mission stream discrepancy certificate importing TNDLib.Cantor.DiscrepancyWitness.
descriptions.TNDLib.Certifying.checkMatchAt2: Computes an executable boolean check for a length-2 binary pattern match at pos.
descriptions.TNDLib.Certifying.diagonalStreamCert: Constructs a universal pattern-table discrepancy certificate by reusing Mission H01's Cantor diagonal theorem.
descriptions.TNDLib.Finite.enumerate: Constructively lists every inhabitant of the explicitly bounded type Fin n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Finite.lengthEnumerate: Shows that the explicit enumeration of Fin n contains exactly n entries.
descriptions.TNDLib.Finite.memEnumerate: Shows that every bounded index occurs in the explicit enumeration of Fin n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Finite.memSelect: Characterizes membership in a finite filter by the supplied decidable predicate.
descriptions.TNDLib.Finite.select: Filters an explicit finite enumeration using a supplied decision procedure.
descriptions.TNDLib.List.splitAt: Returns a prefix and suffix together with recombination and prefix-length evidence.
descriptions.TNDLib.List.splitAtLength: Extracts the certified upper bound on the returned prefix length.
descriptions.TNDLib.List.splitAtPrefix: Identifies the certified split's first component with List.take.
descriptions.TNDLib.List.splitAtRecombine: Shows that concatenating the certified prefix and suffix recovers the input list.
descriptions.TNDLib.List.splitAtSuffix: Identifies the certified split's second component with List.drop.
descriptions.TNDLib.Logic.andOrDistribute: Distributes conjunction over disjunction without deciding either proposition.
descriptions.TNDLib.Logic.decidableDoubleNegation: Eliminates double negation when an explicit decision procedure for the proposition is available.
descriptions.TNDLib.Logic.decidableExcludedMiddle: Derives excluded middle for a proposition from its explicit Decidable instance.
descriptions.TNDLib.Logic.doubleNegatedExcludedMiddle: Proves the double negation of excluded middle without assuming a decision procedure.
descriptions.TNDLib.Logic.notOr: Proves the constructive De Morgan equivalence between not-or and a pair of negations.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.LOrder: Defines the constructive divisibility-cone order relation on natural numbers.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.RelPrime: Defines constructive relative primality (disjointness above 0) in the lattice order.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.join: Computes the constructive lattice join (supremum) of two natural numbers.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.le_meet: Proves the universal greatest-lower-bound property for the lattice meet.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.lorder_of_eq_left: Transports a constructive order bound along an equality on the left operand.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.lorder_of_eq_right: Transports a constructive order bound along an equality on the right operand.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.meet: Computes the constructive lattice meet (infimum) of two natural numbers.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.meet_le_left: Proves that the lattice meet is bounded above by its left operand.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.meet_le_right: Proves that the lattice meet is bounded above by its right operand.
descriptions.TNDLib.Lorenzen.orderCancelLeft: Proves left additive cancellation for the constructive cone order.
descriptions.TNDLib.Nat.leSumTo: Shows that the triangular sum through n is at least n.
descriptions.TNDLib.Nat.sumTo: Computes the sum of the natural numbers from one through the input.
descriptions.TNDLib.Nat.sumToSucc: Exposes the recursive successor equation for the triangular sum.
descriptions.TNDLib.Nat.sumToWitness: Returns a triangular sum together with equality and lower-bound evidence.
descriptions.TNDLib.Predicate.assembleWitnesses: Builds a function and its pointwise specification from explicitly supplied witness data.
descriptions.TNDLib.Predicate.existsOr: Distributes an existential quantifier over disjunction constructively.
descriptions.TNDLib.Predicate.forallAnd: Shows that universal quantification preserves conjunction.
descriptions.TNDLib.Predicate.notExists: Equates negation of an existential with pointwise negation constructively.

citations.TNDLib.Certifying.MismatchWitness2: McConnell, Mehlhorn, Näher, Schweitzer (2011), Comput. Sci. Rev. 5(2), §9.5, pp. 142-143
